origine_fr: Il y a plus de 3 000 ans, 贝 dessinait un cauri, un coquillage qui s'ouvre en deux lèvres. Autrefois, on s'en servait comme monnaie. On le retrouve dans les mots d'argent, comme 贵, cher, ou 买, acheter.
origine_en: Over 3,000 years ago, 贝 was drawn as a cowrie, a shell opening in two lips. Long ago such shells were used as money. You find it in words about money, like 贵, expensive, or 买, to buy.
